title: Fourteen Summers and One Short Report
subtitle: 环境保护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 环境保护（环境保护·环境问题与保护）
meta: 主题语境：环境保护（环境保护·环境问题与保护）　|　核心词汇：ecology　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ecology 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my teacher ① studied the ecology that no farmer in the valley would have named, and he said the studying was the whole of the summer. The ② ecology, meaning the system and not the balance, ran fourteen summers and stayed unnamed in the book; an ecology, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ ecology in that valley had the same short report at the end of it, and the ④ ecology at the end, meaning the one they kept for the wetland and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An ecology, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to study; my teacher said the studying is the part that fills fourteen summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ecology was the whole of the story, meaning the balance and not the system. The ⑥ ecology, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody talks about and nobody guards; ecology, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a system and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ ecology had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short report. The ⑧ ecology of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in July, was one valley and fourteen summers of studying; ecology, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to study. She said the studying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ecology I remember is the one named in the survey, which changed in 1993 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. An ⑩ ecology, my mother said in 1995, is the only one that improves by being studied; every ecology, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like a system. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 生态；生态系统（指那条河谷里研究过的那一套）
B. n. 生态；生态系统（指那套生态本身，与生态平衡相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the ecology 研究一套生态
D. n. 生态；生态系统（指留给湿地的那一套）
E. n. 生态；生态系统（抽象总称，指一条河谷的生态研究之事）
F. n. 生态；生态系统（指考察报告上写到、被列名的那一套）
G. n. 生态平衡；生态意识（指故事里人人都谈论却无人守护的那样东西）
H. n. 生态平衡（抽象总称，指人人都谈论却无人守护的那种状态）

items.q: studied the ecology that no farmer in the valley would have named
The ecology, meaning the system and not the balance
the ecology was the whole of the story
the ecology had become a line in a survey
The ecology of the whole thing
An ecology, my mother said in 1995

answers.why: study the ecology 意为“研究一套生态”，1972 年老师研究了一套河谷里没有一位农户肯说出口的生态。
ecology 意为“生态、生态系统”，指那套生态本身而不是生态平衡，它经过了十四个夏天而在簿子上没有名字。
ecology 意为“生态、生态系统”，指那条河谷里的每一套生态，每一套到头都有同一份短短的报告。
ecology 意为“生态、生态系统”，指留给湿地的那一套，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ecology 意为“生态平衡、生态意识”，指故事里人人都谈论却无人守护的那样东西，叔叔说这份生态平衡就是那个故事的全部。
ecology 意为“生态平衡”，指人人都谈论却无人守护的那种状态而不是那套生态，是故事里人人都谈论、却无人守护的东西。
ecology 意为“生态、生态系统”，指考察报告上写到、被列名的那一套，到 1981 年这套生态成了报告里的一行。
ecology 意为“生态、生态系统”，老师七月写道，整件事的生态研究之事是一条河谷和十四个夏天的研究。
ecology 意为“生态、生态系统”，我记得的是考察报告上列名的那一套，1993 年变了，至今仍被说成河谷里最安静的一套。
ecology 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，一套生态是唯一会因为被好好研究而变得更好的东西。
